result.verdict: DERIVED (sign carrier; g_ρ = jet-order grading): the principal grading g_ρ is the GS/jet-order (word-length / major-index) filtration grading, and n(λ) = min maj(SYT(λ)) is its BOTTOM DEGREE on V_λ — the classical fake-degree valuation (Steinberg/Lusztig/Macdonald I.5). The QOU Gröbner-Shirshov normal-form basis realises this jet-order grading (H_3: orders 0..3; n(λ⊢3)={0,1,3} are the bottom jet-orders where each V_λ enters). The Δ_λ sign (-1)^{n(λ)} is the parity of that valuation. So g_ρ is DERIVED from the driver-level GS filtration — not axiomatised — grounding the Δ_λ sign carrier. Honest scope: the SIGN carrier is derived; the full binding closure (magnitude assembly Δ_λ=tr(g_ρ) into B=m_e Σ y_λ χ^λ Δ_λ + wiring) is a further step. Nothing wired.
